[Computer standard keyboard and mouse mapping table]
• W/A/S/D or direction keys: character walking/vehicle steering/person selection switching
• T or F6: Open the chat input box • TAB: View the online player scoreboard
• F or Enter: Getting in/out of the driver’s seat • G: Getting in the co-pilot’s/passenger’s seat
• Left Ctrl: fire attack / birth confirmation • Left Alt: slow walk / vehicle weapon fire
• Space or Left Shift: Sprint/Vehicle Handbrake • C: Crouch • H: Honk/Interact
• Y/N/2: Server menu confirmation/cancel/side task • Q/E: Look left and right
• Numpad 8 / 4 / 6 / 2: Aircraft pitch and hydraulic control • B or V: Voice microphone speaking
• F7: Show/hide chat box • F8: Save high-definition game screenshots immediately
